# Patient Administration System

> Hospital patient administration: admissions, appointments, waiting lists, referrals, reminders and patient notifications, with a patient portal and staff tools. Rust server (Axum, PostgreSQL), SvelteKit UI (Keycloak sign-in), Podman development stack. Pre-1.0, not production-ready and unaudited; it does not pass its own NHS DTAC self-assessment.

Behaviour is defined by the specification in spec/, and a change is spec + code + test together. Each requirement names the test that verifies it, or says "not yet tested". The REST API describes itself: a running server serves OpenAPI at /api-docs/openapi.json and Swagger UI at /swagger-ui/. Everything under governance/ is an unreviewed draft.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Overview, repository layout, quick start
- [Install](INSTALL.md): Run the stack locally with Podman, then the server and the UI
- [Tasks](tasks.md): The live work queue: what is done, with its evidence, and what is not
- [Plan](plan.md): Research and reasoning behind the tasks

## Specification

- [Specification index](spec/index.md): Source of truth for the cross-subproject contract and the ground rules
- [Domain model](spec/05-domain-model.md): Entities, appointment statuses, delivery channels, template variables
- [Functional requirements](spec/06-functional-requirements.md): FR-n, each with the test that verifies it
- [Non-functional requirements](spec/07-non-functional-requirements.md): NFR-n, each with the test that verifies it
- [Architecture](spec/08-architecture.md): Components, the backend-for-frontend, the transactional outbox
- [API surface](spec/09-api-surface.md): The endpoints the recent work depends on
- [Persistence](spec/10-persistence.md): PostgreSQL, migrations and their rules
- [Testing strategy](spec/11-testing-strategy.md): Which tests run where, and the rules about skipping
- [Compliance](spec/12-compliance.md): Honest status against GDPR, clinical safety, DTAC, WCAG
- [Implementation status](spec/14-implementation-status.md): Generated counts of tests, routes, migrations, tasks
- [Locales](spec/locales.md): Locale codes, locale-prefixed URLs, catalogues, and what is tested
- [Spec-driven development](agents/spec-driven-development.md): Spec, code and test change together

## Subprojects

- [Server (Rust)](patient-administration-system-with-rust/README.md): Axum API: ADT, scheduling, waiting list, letters, reminders, write-back, standby, contact profiles
- [Server specification](patient-administration-system-with-rust/spec.md): Crate-level specification; wins over the root spec on crate internals
- [Server agent notes](patient-administration-system-with-rust/AGENTS.md): Conventions and layout for working in the server crate
- [Operator pages (Loco)](patient-administration-system-frontend/README.md): Server-rendered operator pages over the shared database
- [UI (SvelteKit)](patient-administration-system-ui-with-svelte/README.md): Patient and staff UI: Keycloak sign-in, ten locales, Lily components
- [UI specification](patient-administration-system-ui-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Routes, roles, components, security, tests
- [Development stack](podman/compose.yml): PostgreSQL 18 and Keycloak 26 under Podman
- [Keycloak realm](podman/keycloak/pas-realm.json): Development realm: roles patient, staff, admin; development users only

## Governance (drafts, unreviewed)

- [Governance index](governance/README.md): What each draft feeds and its status
- [NHS DTAC v2.0 self-assessment](docs/united-kingdom/national-health-service/digital-technology-assessment-criteria/2.0/index.md): Question-by-question answers; concludes the product would not pass today
- [DPIA](governance/dpia.md): Data protection impact assessment draft
- [Clinical safety hazard log](governance/clinical-safety.md): Hazards found in the design, for a Clinical Safety Officer to score
- [ISO 14971 mapping](governance/risk-management-iso-14971.md): How the hazard log lines up with ISO 14971, and what is missing
- [Personal-data inventory](governance/personal-data-inventory.csv): Every database column classified; a test fails if one is missing
- [Retention schedule](governance/retention-schedule.md): Placeholders; no retention job exists yet
- [Translation review](governance/translation-review.md): Non-English catalogues are AI drafts awaiting first-language review
- [Production readiness](governance/production-readiness.md): Checklist of what is and is not done
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): Reporting a vulnerability, and the known limits
- [AI statement](AI_STATEMENT.md): How AI was used to build this
